Product Details: Makita DML812 14.4V/18V Li-ion LXT Flashlight – Batteries and Charger Not Included - Distributed/Packaged by Makita. Product Details: Makita is the leading manufacturer of professional power tools on the market. The DML812 is a bright light Flashlight, with a maximum luminous flux of 1,250 lm, powered by 14.4V or 18V Li-ion LXT slide type battery (not included), for a long beam distance of up to 640 metres in spot mode (the distance at which the illumination decreases to 0.25 lx). The DML812 is a 4 in 1 Flashlight. There are 4 lighting modes available; spot mode, flood mode (for wide illumination of a target area), spot plus flood mode and strobe mode (the Flashlight flashes in Spot and Flood mode). The mode switch cycles through Flood, Spot, Spot and Flood. Press and hold for Strobe. The DML812 is equipped with a variable angle head that can be moved through 90 degrees as desired, a bracket hook to enable the Flashlight to be hung from joists, pipes or scaffolding and an on/off button switch with a memory function that allows the user to start in the same lighting mode as the last time before the Flashlight was switched off. The lighting mode selection button is not integrated with the on/off button switch for user convenience. The DML812 features battery protection system designed to automatically cut off the output power for longer service life and eXtreme Protection Technology (XPT) for improved dust and water resistance for use when operating in harsher weather conditions. The DML812 is not compatible with G-Series batteries. 1 year manufacturer warranty. This guarantee does not apply where non-genuine or recommended parts or accessories are fitted to the tool. The use of non-genuine or compatible batteries and chargers with Makita tools will invalidate the Makita guarantee for our tools.
